status_detail: City of Stillwater says a U.S.-based Fortune 100 company could construct up to six data centers, with first two phases about 300,000 sq ft each and Phase I possible as early as 2027; later local reporting identified Google. Tracker pages list six 110 MW planned buildings.
notes: Official city project page/project plan establish the campus, phases, PILOTs, and location south of E Richmond Rd/north of E Airport Rd/east of N Perkins Rd/west of N Jardot Rd. Capacity is from Cleanview tracker, not the official project plan.

status_detail: Pittsburg County official notices list Emerald ProjectCo Data Center public hearings and project-plan/TID records. Local reporting says the TID review committee advanced tax plans in April 2026, commissioners tabled the June 22, 2026 decision, and IREN plans a 2,000-acre complex south of Kiowa with construction targeted to begin in 2027. IREN and Cleanview list 1,600 MW.
notes: County site has public hearing notices/resolution entries; news adds meeting status and local detail. Status kept planned because local incentive action was tabled as of June 22, 2026, despite developer/tracker project listing.

status_detail: City of Claremore official pages identify Project Mustang as a proposed data center development led by Beale Infrastructure within Claremore Industrial Park, with public hearings on May 4 and May 18, 2026 for the Claremore Mustang Data Center Economic Development Project Plan. The official project-plan page describes three incentive districts and a large-scale data center campus; local reports indicate City Council approval of the tax incentive package. Tracker pages list planned operation in 2028 on about 270 acres.
notes: Capacity not publicly disclosed in official sources found. Project area legal descriptions are in Rogers County; official FAQ says facility is air-cooled with dedicated GRDA substation/direct transmission feed.

project_name: Unnamed Seminole Nation data center proposal
status_detail: Native News Online and KGOU/KOSU report that a startup approached the Seminole Nation Tribal Council seeking an NDA and letter of intent to develop a data center on Seminole lands. On March 7, 2026, the Tribal Council voted 24-0 for a moratorium barring inquiries, discussions, or development of data centers within the Seminole Nation during the moratorium period.
notes: Included because the Seminole Nation jurisdiction covers portions of Seminole County and the brief counts early/rejected projects. No concrete county-government data center project was found; county official site itself is a general new website with no project details surfaced.
